data.one_liner: Plugin to scan barcodes on Honeywell Android PDA devices using the native Honeywell SDK.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the Honeywell Data Collection Android SDK to provide barcode scanning on supported Honeywell devices. The plugin exposes callbacks for decoded data and errors and allows property customization.
use_when: You need barcode scanning on Honeywell PDA hardware
You require the full feature set of the Honeywell SDK (e.g., specific code formats, trigger control)
You are building an Android‑only app for enterprise devices
avoid_when: Targeting iOS or generic Android devices
You want a plug‑and‑play solution without native setup
You prefer a pure Dart/Flutter implementation
strengths: Supports a wide range of Honeywell models
Uses the official Honeywell SDK for reliable hardware access
Allows detailed property configuration and error callbacks
weaknesses: Requires manual native integration steps (copy .aar, gradle changes)
Higher setup complexity compared to pure‑Flutter scanners
data.setup_notes: Copy the provided honeywell folder into the Android module, add ':honeywell' to settings.gradle, add tools:replace="android:label" in AndroidManifest, ensure the Honeywell Data Collection .aar is referenced, and download the Honeywell SDK from the Honeywell portal.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure‑Flutter barcode scanner that works on all Android and iOS devices without native SDK setup

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses ML Kit for cross‑platform barcode scanning with no hardware‑specific dependencies
